title: And That's How The Demon King Crumbles

lines.speaker: Dabura
lines.text: Master, I beseech you! Look at this thing!

lines.speaker: Dabura
lines.text: It cannot be trusted or controlled! It is not a child!

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Yes, Dabura, he is a child.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: A child that must be nurtured and raised into a subservient, obedient little...

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Dabura? Dabura? Where did you go?

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Man, Towa's going to be really pissed at me.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Ah, who gives a shit? Bitch is barely canon.
